issue.body:
## Problem

The pack hook needs the `sk-pack` tool, and a contributor without it installed gets a hook error.

## Fix

Ship a prebuilt `sk-pack` in `plugins/sample-kit/bin/` and say in the README that the hook runs it from there.

## Done when

- [ ] `plugins/sample-kit/bin/sk-pack` is in the repository and executable.
- [ ] The README names where the hook finds `sk-pack`.

pr.title: feat(sample-kit): ship a prebuilt sk-pack for the pack hook
pr.body: Adds the prebuilt `sk-pack` binary and documents where the pack hook finds it.
